title: review-tool-probe
description: The commands of a sub agent. Each answers one line of JSON and exits with 0 for an answer and 1 for a failure.

oneOf.title: instructions
oneOf.description: instructions <probe>: answers the instructions of the probe.

oneOf.title: ack
oneOf.description: ack <probe> <acknowledgement>: acknowledges the instructions and answers the progress, or answers more detailed instructions when the acknowledgement is not the one asked for.

oneOf.title: rules
oneOf.description: rules <probe>: answers the rules of the probe.

oneOf.title: define
oneOf.description: define <probe> <term>: answers the definition of the term.

oneOf.title: next
oneOf.description: next <probe>: answers the next page of the surface.

oneOf.title: prev
oneOf.description: prev <probe>: answers the previous page of the surface.
